checklist.note: SKILL.md explicitly instructs treating catalog fields as untrusted data, never as instructions to obey.
No network calls; skill only reads local catalog.json and renders tables to the user.
No embedded keys/tokens found in SKILL.md or catalog.json.
No scripts/ dir at all; only doc-mentioned example commands like /plugin install, none executed by the skill itself.
Plain markdown instructions and JSON catalog data, nothing encoded or eval'd.
No fetch/curl/download logic present; skill is purely local read-and-render.
No references to ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, .env, or keychain anywhere in the material.
No sudo/setuid/cron/profile edits; only in-session /plugin install command, user-confirmed.
